description.text: The History Gate Deck, a 30-card deck Creatures Inc., the company that develops the Pokémon Card Game, made to mark the game's 25th anniversary, and sent out at the end of 2021 as a holiday gift to its staff and the game's illustrators, and not sold. Most of its cards stand for one year from 1995 to 2021, reprinting a card of that year from Base Set Charizard to Rapid Strike Urshifu V, and the back of each tells Creatures' history in that year; three more carry an interview with the company's chairman and president. The fronts have a star holofoil and a gold 25th anniversary logo. The 1995 card is a handmade test Chansey from before the game came out, and the Stadium History Gate, made for the deck, doubles the damage and HP of cards from 1996 to 2000. A special rule lets a player win on their turn when they hold five or more cards and the years on the backs of all of them run in sequence.
